title: Bundles
subtitle_page: Several products ordered together at a discount — shown in “Bundle deals” on the home page
name: Bundle name
subtitle: Short description (optional)
products_hint: 2 to 10 — one piece of each, with its price in the bundle
price_note: Each product has one bundle price for all its sizes and colours — the percentage is calculated automatically
banner_hint: One wide image — shown on the home page and the bundle page
hidden_home_hint: The bundle page still works from its link (for ads) without showing on the home page
err_discount: The bundle price must be lower than the regular total
empty_desc: Group products bought together (e.g. bodysuit + pants + hat) at a discount — the customer orders them all in one order.
slider_title: Section title on the home page
title_hint: Leave it empty and save to show the section without a title
theme_unsupported_title: Your current theme doesn't show bundles on the home page yet
theme_unsupported_desc: Bundles are saved and each bundle's page link works (for ads), but they won't appear on the home page until this theme supports them or you pick a theme that does.
err_price: Enter the price of each product in the bundle
options_hint: Leave empty to use the product bundle price — an option that is off is hidden from the bundle page
sec_info_desc: Name and description as the customer sees them
summary_empty: Add at least two products to see the bundle price
active_hint: An inactive bundle is hidden and can’t be ordered
sec_schedule_desc: Optional — leave empty to keep the offer running
